### 0. Settings

```{r}
# install.packages(c("bootUR", "vars"))

library(bootUR)
library(vars)
```

### 1. Data preparation

```{r}
# Load the FRED-MD CSV
raw <- read.csv("v2-2026-rev-08-MD.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# FRED-MD transformation codes for the selected variables
fred_codes <- unlist(
  raw[1, c("INDPRO", "CPIAUCSL", "FEDFUNDS")]
)

# Keep only the variables used in the case study
dat <- raw[, c(
  "sasdate",
  "INDPRO",
  "CPIAUCSL",
  "FEDFUNDS"
)]

names(dat)[1] <- "Date"

dat$Date <- as.Date(
  dat$Date,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)

dat <- dat[
  !is.na(dat$Date) &
    dat$Date <= as.Date("2019-12-31"),
]

dat <- dat[order(dat$Date), ]

fred_codes
```

### 2. Series transformation

```{r}
dat_transformed <- data.frame(
  Date = dat$Date,

  INDPRO = c(
    NA,
    diff(log(dat$INDPRO))
  ),

  CPIAUCSL = c(
    NA,
    NA,
    diff(
      log(dat$CPIAUCSL),
      differences = 2
    )
  ),

  FEDFUNDS = c(
    NA,
    diff(dat$FEDFUNDS)
  )
)

# Common sample starts in March 1959
dat_common <- dat[-c(1, 2), ]

dat_transformed <- dat_transformed[
  -c(1, 2),
]

common_start <- c(
  as.integer(
    format(dat_common$Date[1], "%Y")
  ),
  as.integer(
    format(dat_common$Date[1], "%m")
  )
)

# Original series
levels_ts <- ts(
  dat_common[, c(
    "INDPRO",
    "CPIAUCSL",
    "FEDFUNDS"
  )],
  start = common_start,
  frequency = 12
)

# Transformed series
transformed_ts <- ts(
  dat_transformed[, c(
    "INDPRO",
    "CPIAUCSL",
    "FEDFUNDS"
  )],
  start = common_start,
  frequency = 12
)

range(dat_transformed$Date)
```

### 3. Series in levels

```{r}
plot(
  levels_ts[, "INDPRO"],
  main = "Industrial Production",
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Index"
)
```

```{r}

```


### 4. Transformed series

```{r}
plot(
  transformed_ts[, "INDPRO"],
  main = "Output Growth",
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = expression(
    Delta~log(INDPRO)
  )
)
```

```{r}
plot(
  transformed_ts[, "CPIAUCSL"],
  main = "Change in Inflation",
  xlab = "Year",

  )
)
```

```{r}

  )
)
```

### 5. Unit root testing

```{r}
# Series considered for the VAR

IP  <- log(dat$INDPRO)
CPI <- log(dat$CPIAUCSL)
FFR <- dat$FEDFUNDS

# Bootstrap settings

set.seed(123)
B <- 4999


# Trend specification

IP_trend <- order_integration(
  IP,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "trend",
  B = B
)

CPI_trend <- order_integration(
  CPI,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "trend",
  B = B
)

FFR_trend <- order_integration(
  FFR,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "trend",
  B = B
)

trend_orders <- c(
  IP  = unname(IP_trend$order_int),
  CPI = unname(CPI_trend$order_int),
  FFR = unname(FFR_trend$order_int)
)


# Intercept specification

IP_intercept <- order_integration(
  IP,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "intercept",
  B = B
)

CPI_intercept <- order_integration(
  CPI,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "intercept",
  B = B
)

FFR_intercept <- order_integration(
  FFR,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "intercept",
  B = B
)

intercept_orders <- c(
  IP  = unname(IP_intercept$order_int),
  CPI = unname(CPI_intercept$order_int),
  FFR = unname(FFR_intercept$order_int)
)


# Compare deterministic specifications

unit_root_table <- data.frame(
  Series = c(
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "FFR"
  ),

  Trend = as.integer(
    trend_orders
  ),

  Intercept = as.integer(
    intercept_orders
  ),

  Different = (
    trend_orders != intercept_orders
  )
)

unit_root_table


# Manual unit roots with boot_adf()

urip1 <- boot_adf(diff(diff(IP)), deterministics = "intercept", B = B)
urip2 <- boot_adf(diff(IP), deterministics = "intercept", B = B)
urip3 <- boot_adf(IP, deterministics = "trend", B = B)

urcpi1 <- boot_adf(diff(diff(CPI)), deterministics = "intercept", B = B)
urcpi2 <- boot_adf(diff(CPI), deterministics = "intercept", B = B)
urcpi3 <- boot_adf(CPI, deterministics = "trend", B = B)

urffr1 <- boot_adf(diff(diff(FFR)), deterministics = "intercept", B = B)
urffr2 <- boot_adf(diff(FFR), deterministics = "intercept", B = B)
urffr3 <- boot_adf(FFR, deterministics = "trend", B = B)

unit_root_table_manual <- data.frame(
  Series = c(
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "FFR"
  ),
  
  Delta_2_P = c(
    urip1$p.value,
    urcpi1$p.value,
    urffr1$p.value
  ),
  
  Delta_1_P = c(
    urip2$p.value,
    urcpi2$p.value,
    urffr2$p.value
  ),
  
  Delta_0_P = c(
    urip3$p.value,
    urcpi3$p.value,
    urffr3$p.value
  ),
  
  Order = c(
    as.numeric(1),
    as.numeric(1),
    as.numeric(1)
  )
)

unit_root_table_manual
```

### 6. Selected integration order

```{r}
# Selected deterministic specifications:

selected_integration_table <- data.frame(
  Series = c(
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "FFR"
  ),

  Deterministic = c(
    "Trend",
    "Trend",
    "Intercept"
  ),

  Integration_order = c(
    trend_orders["IP"],
    trend_orders["CPI"],
    intercept_orders["FFR"]
  )
)

selected_integration_table
```

### 7. VAR setup

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05

Y <- data.frame(
  Date = dat_transformed$Date,
  IP   = dat_transformed$INDPRO,
  CPI  = dat_transformed$CPIAUCSL,
  FFR  = dat_transformed$FEDFUNDS
)

x <- as.matrix(
  Y[, c(
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "FFR"
  )]
)

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(x))
)

c(
  observations = nrow(x),
  variables = ncol(x)
)
```

### 8. Lag order selection

```{r}
# Allow up to two years of monthly lags
lag_max <- 24

lag_selection <- VARselect(
  x,
  lag.max = lag_max,
  type = "const"
)

lag_table <- data.frame(
  Criterion = c(
    "AIC",
    "HQ",
    "SC / BIC",
    "FPE"
  ),

  Selected_lag = as.integer(c(
    lag_selection$selection[["AIC(n)"]],
    lag_selection$selection[["HQ(n)"]],
    lag_selection$selection[["SC(n)"]],
    lag_selection$selection[["FPE(n)"]]
  ))
)

lag_criteria <- lag_selection$criteria

p_aic <- as.integer(
  lag_selection$selection[["AIC(n)"]]
)

p_bic <- as.integer(
  lag_selection$selection[["SC(n)"]]
)

# Display selected lag orders
lag_table
```

```{r}
# Display criterion values for all candidate lags
lag_criteria
```

### 9. Estimation VAR models

```{r}
fit_aic <- VAR(
  x,
  p = p_aic,
  type = "const"
)

fit_bic <- VAR(
  x,
  p = p_bic,
  type = "const"
)

c(
  AIC_selected_lag = p_aic,
  BIC_selected_lag = p_bic
)
```

### 10. VAR stability

```{r}
roots_aic <- roots(
  fit_aic,
  modulus = TRUE
)

roots_bic <- roots(
  fit_bic,
  modulus = TRUE
)

stability_table <- data.frame(
  Specification = c(
    paste0(
      "AIC VAR(",
      p_aic,
      ")"
    ),
    paste0(
      "SC/BIC VAR(",
      p_bic,
      ")"
    )
  ),

  Max_root = c(
    max(roots_aic),
    max(roots_bic)
  ),

  Stable = c(
    all(roots_aic < 1),
    all(roots_bic < 1)
  )
)

stability_table
```

### 11. Residual diagnostics

```{r}
# Common two-year residual-autocorrelation horizon
serial_horizon <- 24

stopifnot(
  p_aic < serial_horizon,
  p_bic < serial_horizon
)

run_var_diagnostics <- function(
  fit,
  serial_horizon
) {

  root_moduli <- roots(
    fit,
    modulus = TRUE
  )

  serial_result <- serial.test(
    fit,
    lags.pt = serial_horizon,
    type = "PT.adjusted"
  )

  arch_result <- arch.test(
    fit
  )

  normality_result <- normality.test(
    fit
  )

  list(
    lag = fit$p,

    roots = root_moduli,

    stable = all(
      root_moduli < 1
    ),

    max_root = max(
      root_moduli
    ),

    serial_test = serial_result,

    serial_p = as.numeric(
      serial_result$serial$p.value
    ),

    arch_test = arch_result,

    arch_p = as.numeric(
      arch_result$arch.mul$p.value
    ),

    normality_test = normality_result,

    normality_p = as.numeric(
      normality_result$jb.mul$JB$p.value
    )
  )
}

diag_aic <- run_var_diagnostics(
  fit_aic,
  serial_horizon
)

diag_bic <- run_var_diagnostics(
  fit_bic,
  serial_horizon
)
```

### 12. Diagnostic results

```{r}
diagnostic_table <- data.frame(
  Criterion = c(
    "AIC",
    "SC / BIC"
  ),

  Selected_lag = c(
    diag_aic$lag,
    diag_bic$lag
  ),

  Stable = c(
    diag_aic$stable,
    diag_bic$stable
  ),

  Max_root = c(
    diag_aic$max_root,
    diag_bic$max_root
  ),

  Serial_p = c(
    diag_aic$serial_p,
    diag_bic$serial_p
  ),

  ARCH_p = c(
    diag_aic$arch_p,
    diag_bic$arch_p
  ),

  Normality_p = c(
    diag_aic$normality_p,
    diag_bic$normality_p
  )
)

diagnostic_table$Serial_correlation <- ifelse(
  diagnostic_table$Serial_p < alpha,
  "Rejected",
  "Not rejected"
)

diagnostic_table$ARCH_effects <- ifelse(
  diagnostic_table$ARCH_p < alpha,
  "Rejected",
  "Not rejected"
)

diagnostic_table$Normality <- ifelse(
  diagnostic_table$Normality_p < alpha,
  "Rejected",
  "Not rejected"
)

diagnostic_table
```
